seed_data_info: MK-001 has device key configured. Key is SHA-256 hashed and stored in device_key_hash field. Only prefix (first 8 chars) is visible after generation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 complete. Per-device key management fully implemented and tested: (1) generate-key endpoint creates 48-char hex key, stores SHA-256 hash (2) key-info endpoint shows has_key status and prefix (3) ingest endpoint authenticates with device key (4) sync-state endpoint works with device key (5) Download endpoints for Pi sync files (emu_sync.py, emu_sync.service, emu_sync.conf) all working. Legacy global key still works as fallback. Frontend shows DeviceKeySection only for existing Messkoffer devices (not new ones).

security_notes.key_storage: Device keys stored as SHA-256 hash (device_key_hash field) - plain key never stored
security_notes.key_display: Plain key returned only once during generation - must be saved by admin
security_notes.key_prefix: Only first 8 chars stored in device_key_prefix for identification
security_notes.authentication: HMAC constant-time comparison used for key verification
